AGENDA_CARD_APPEND_MISMATCH: Blocks appended to the Agenda card did not read back as written.
Check the page; retried next run.
AGENDA_CARD_NOT_OWNED: The Agenda card block is not one V7 owns, so nothing is changed.
None; the card never edits what it does not own.
AGENDA_CARD_STALE_NO_BASELINE: The snapshot is stale and V7 has not written this card yet, so there is nothing known-good to keep showing.
AGENDA_CARD_VERIFY_FAILED: The Agenda card did not read back as written.
AGENDA_EVENT_INVALID: A calendar event is not valid and is left out.
None; check the event if it matters.
AGENDA_LISTING_INCOMPLETE: The calendar listing did not finish paging.
AGENDA_LISTING_INVALID: The calendar listing repeated a cursor or was malformed.
AGENDA_NOTION_PAGE_INCOMPLETE: A Notion page read for the Agenda card was incomplete.
AGENDA_NOTION_PAGINATION_INCOMPLETE: A Notion list for the Agenda card did not finish paging.
AGENDA_NOTION_PAGINATION_INVALID: Notion paging for the Agenda card repeated a cursor.
AGENDA_PROTECTED_REGION_CHANGED: Jim's protected content changed during a write, so the write stops.
None; nothing of Jim's is overwritten.
AGENDA_PROTECTED_REGION_UNAVAILABLE: A protected block could not be read, so no write is made.
AGENDA_READ_FAILED: The calendar could not be read.
AGENDA_SNAPSHOT_INVALID: The stored Agenda snapshot is not valid.
AGENDA_SNAPSHOT_MISSING: No Agenda snapshot is stored yet.
None; the snapshot stage runs first.
AGENDA_STORE_FAILED: The Agenda snapshot could not be stored.
